question: Will Adanech Abiebie be the next Prime Minister of Ethiopia?
description:
General elections are scheduled to be held in Ethiopia on June 1, 2026.

This market will resolve to the next individual who officially assumes the office of Prime Minister of Ethiopia following the 2026 General elections.

To count for resolution, the individual must be officially appointed and sworn in as Prime Minister of Ethiopia. Any interim or caretaker Prime Minister will not count toward the resolution of this market.

If no such Prime Minister takes office by December 31, 2028, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Government of Ethiopia; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the UN recognized government of Venezuela. If the Government of Venezuela does not clearly state who is the head of state, information from the UN and a consensus of credible reporting may be used.

This continuity of Chavista structures, combined with the absence of scheduled presidential elections through late 2026 and limited opposition participation in ongoing US-backed talks, underpins trader consensus favoring Maduro’s long-term positioning or Rodríguez’s succession over challengers. Figures such as María Corina Machado and Edmundo González remain in exile amid warnings of legal repercussions, while other military and political names stay marginal due to the regime’s consolidation and lack of immediate transition triggers.

eventMetadata.context_description: The tight contest between Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and J.D. Vance at roughly even implied probabilities stems from their shared alignment with core Republican voter priorities on issues like regulatory reform and foreign policy restraint, while diverging in base appeal. Vance benefits from vice presidential visibility and institutional positioning within the current administration, yet faces questions over policy execution that have kept his edge narrow. Kennedy Jr. draws strength from independent voter crossover and health-focused messaging that resonates in early polling among certain factions. Marco Rubio trails as a more establishment option despite his Senate and diplomatic experience. Developments such as Trump-era endorsements, primary debate performances, state-level polling shifts, or coalition realignments could widen separation ahead of the 2028 convention.
